chapter_title_en: Wind Rises Overseas: The Execution and the Teleportation Formation
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 566: Han Li's Double-Edged Victory - Teleportation Found, But a New Trap Closes
chapter_meta_description: Han Li eliminates the demonic sect guards to secure a one-way teleportation to the inner sea. His victory, however, is tainted by the gnawing anxiety of the Wind Spirit Restriction.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 566: A Clean Kill and a Dirty Clock
og_description: Han Li’s surgical strike clears a path to freedom—but the Wind Spirit Restriction ticks louder than ever.
twitter_title: RMJI 566: Han Li cleans house in under 10 seconds. His reward? A one-way ticket to the inner sea and the haunting dread of an immortal curse.
twitter_description: This chapter is a brutal lesson in efficiency and anxiety as Han Li finally secures his escape route.

lore_anchors.definition: A complex array of runes and spirit stones used to instantaneously transport cultivators across vast distances; in the Mortal Stream, such knowledge is precious and often one-way.
A rare spatial-attunement material essential for completing high-grade teleportation formations; its name hints at its ability to connect distant 'dreams' of space.
The second major realm of cultivation, representing a stable foundation for magical power; cultivators at this stage are formidable, but are utterly outclassed by Core Formation cultivators.

The third major realm, where a cultivator condenses their power into a solid core; the gulf between Core Formation and Foundation Establishment is absolute, making Han Li a walking god to these enemies.
An insidious energy lock planted by a higher-realm cultivator. It can be triggered remotely to cause excruciating pain or death, serving as a leash for a captive.
A rare and powerful swarm of spiritual insects owned by Han Li, prized for their ability to devour magical treasures and energy.
A powerful, Yang-aligned lightning technique wielded by Han Li, highly effective against evil and Yin-type forces.
